gapQuestions.rationale: Rung finds no expansion and control horizon contraction; regression does not identify mediator.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Loss aversion and risk aversion are synonymous.
gapQuestions.rationale: Gain/loss reference sensitivity differs from uncertain-versus-certain preference.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Loss-aversion estimate causes the loss-aversion construct.
gapQuestions.rationale: Estimator does not independently cause its construct; no parameter graph weight.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Changed expectations shift outcome reference point.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reference point equals goal discrepancy.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Experienced outcomes change probability weighting.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A probability-weighting curve has one universal increase direction.
gapQuestions.rationale: Curves can cross; specify pointwise/parameter interpretation, not graph weights.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Disclosing probabilities reduces ambiguity aversion by definition.
gapQuestions.rationale: Disclosure changes ambiguity of option, not necessarily preference conditional on ambiguity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cultural/economic context associates with risk/time preferences.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cross-country preference differences establish cultural causation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Selection, opportunity, measurement invariance and shared context remain alternatives.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Dopaminergic drug exposure changes effort discounting.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Choosing effortful work proves improved cognitive capacity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Effort valuation/motivation is not performance capacity; no pharmacologic recommendation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Natural-scene images reduce delay discounting.
gapQuestions.rationale: Images before/during hypothetical tasks differ from actual natural environment exposure; replication/curve and scope required.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: An image of nature is the actual environmental exposure.
gapQuestions.rationale: Informational image origin and physical setting are separate; no source-Layer substitution.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: More options raise decision conflict.
gapQuestions.rationale: Choice-overload heterogeneity and outcome proxy mismatch; correction-linked newer review not used as exact evidence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Choice deferral or longer reaction time equals decision conflict.
gapQuestions.rationale: Performance/behavior can have multiple causes and is not latent tension by definition.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reference point moderates exact fear-to-risk REL-PSY-026.
gapQuestions.rationale: No exact-edge independently identified interaction extracted; reuse F05 review rather than ordinary causal workaround.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Default→endorsement→preference is a causal pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Meta-coded mechanisms and choice changes do not identify pathway-specific transmitted effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Social feedback changes reference or risk preference.
gapQuestions.rationale: Social comparison and endorsement plausible; no aligned isolated source Driver and reference measure extracted.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Institutional defaults or technological interfaces change valuation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Same preselection identity may recur across delivery contexts; choice behavior not exact mental target; no duplicate identities.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Prior loss temporally precedes altered risk preference.
gapQuestions.rationale: Sequence alone is not causation or state transition; require actual repeated scope rather than plausible ordering.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Delay and effort discounting are the same process.
gapQuestions.rationale: Time delay and effort cost are different dimensions, despite similar fitted functions.
